facts.fact: We Are Tech Africa describes the "Technological New Deal" as the government's "recently launched" digital strategy, naming no act or adopting body; the article's date is used because it gives no launch date.

systems.tiers: national; includes training 100,000 digital graduates and STEM in all educational cycles

systems.owner: Ministry of National Education with Sonatel Foundation

note: Article calls the New Deal the government's recently launched digital strategy; the class national rests on its stated scope (digital training and education targets across cycles) plus the strategy's description elsewhere only partly; no period, plan cost or report.
